item.title: Preseterizer 0.1.2
item.description:
• On a pack's page, click anywhere on a preset's row (or a ladder rung) to tick it for Use as seeds, and click again to untick it. Play and ✕ still do only their own job, and a ticked row stays lit.
  • Clicking How weird no longer draws a highlight round the slider. The arrow keys still step it.
